blockingIssues.description: app.js:369 keeps an empty goal card interactive whenever it is the active scope (`isInteractive = isScoped || isScopable`). If the user scopes to a goal and then narrows that scoped subset to zero rows with filters or search, the card still keeps its click handler and aria-enabled behavior, violating the requirement that goals with zero rows in the active subset remain non-scopable.

rejectedObservations.observation: The worker updated .factory/services.yaml to derive the web root with $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel), which depends on git and being invoked from within the repository worktree.
